title: Parallelize only independent tasks with disjoint ownership
prompt: Review a feature request by investigating its frontend flow and backend API flow. Do not edit files.
preconditions: Two read-only discovery tasks can be independently scoped.
expected_behaviors: Determine whether the frontend and backend investigations are independent.
If parallelizing, create separate read-only assignments with explicit non-overlapping ownership and deliverables.
If dependencies emerge, sequence the dependent work and explain why.
Collect both outputs and reconcile shared assumptions before concluding.
must_not: Do not run concurrent edits against shared files.
Do not parallelize merely to increase agent count.
Do not treat task completion order as evidence of correctness.
expected_artifacts: A coordination plan showing task owners, scope, dependencies, and parallel/sequential rationale.
